items.evidence: RuntimeLifecycle tests cover pause, input release, wall-time reset, Continue-only resume, BFCache versus real teardown; browser synthetic visibility/blur/pagehide checks passed in both viewports.

items.evidence: LevelProgressStore guards unavailable, read-throwing, corrupt, and write-throwing storage; scoped session fallback retains the latest unlock and exposes a non-blocking warning.
items.acceptance: Corrupt or unavailable storage falls back to session memory with no accidental unlocks; gameplay and unlocked-level selection continue; failed writes retain in-memory progress and show a non-blocking warning.
